features.subtitleGenDescription: When Chinese subtitles are unavailable, use a model to translate subtitles from another language into Chinese external subtitle files
features.ingestWatchDescription: Watch download folders and automatically organize completed downloads into the library
features.libraryWatchDescription: Scan changes to library folders incrementally; turn this on or off in each library’s edit settings
features.boostDescription: Download and seed according to site rules, yielding when upload bandwidth is constrained
features.arrivalsDescription: Send notifications when new titles are added to a library
features.cloudDescription: Connect this server to your MovieClaw account for official push notifications and other cloud services
features.discoveryDescription: Let MovieClaw apps, Infuse and other Jellyfin clients find this server automatically on the local network
